mapper.select: select d.* from notify_delivery d join notify_channel_account a on a.channel = 'SMS' and a.config_key = d.provider_key where d.channel = 'SMS' and d.status = 'ACCEPTED' and d.provider_message_id is not null and d.provider_message_id <> '' and d.accepted_at <= timestampadd(second, -60, #{now}) and d.accepted_at > timestampadd(hour, -71, #{now}) and (d.receipt_query_at is null or d.receipt_query_at <= #{now}) and a.enabled = 'Y' and a.del_flag = '0' and a.supplier in ('tencent', 'alibaba') order by coalesce(d.receipt_query_at, d.accepted_at), d.delivery_id limit 1
